text.p: Tropical Cyclone Ophelia is becoming less of a threat to shipping. The storm is in the South Indian Ocean about midway between Java and the Northwest Australia coast, moving south at 5 mph. Top winds are 40 mph and will continue to weaken gradually as the storm moves southward, dissipating within 24-48 hours. The threat to the Northwest Australia coast has diminished but we will continue to watch this weather system.

Tropical Depression 41W is a minor threat to shipping in the southern South China Sea. The depression has 30 mph winds and is centered near 5n/109e, moving west at 1 mph. It should remain over open waters and dissipate within 12-24 hours.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY WEATHER STATEMENTS
